extracted.intended_audience: Singapore citizens, members of the public, and stakeholders interested in engaging with the Singapore Government
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the mandate and aims of a government public-engagement agency (REACH) responsible for soliciting and facilitating citizen views, whole-of-government engagement, and e-engagement. Useful for understanding principles and goals that should guide public consultations and citizen outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listen to your views
rubrics_metrics.description: REACH is here to listen to your views.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expresses the primary function of the agency — to gather citizens' views on national and social issues. No additional scoring guidance provided; implies that successful engagement activities should prioritize soliciting and hearing public input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead agency for facilitating Whole-of-Government efforts
rubrics_metrics.description: REACH is the lead agency in facilitating Whole-of-Government efforts to engage and connect with you, our fellow citizens, on national and social issues that are close to your hearts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates REACH's coordinating role across government agencies; effective engagement should be cross-agency and coordinated to address issues of public concern.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a level of openness between the Government and Singaporeans
rubrics_metrics.description: We aim to create a level of openness between the Government and Singaporeans, working together to establish continued conversations, community participation and collaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets an evaluative goal for engagement: interactions should foster transparency and ongoing dialogue, encourage community participation, and enable collaboration between government and citizens.

rubrics_metrics.name: E-engagement platform role
rubrics_metrics.description: In January 2009, REACH was appointed the Singapore Government’s e-engagement platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals that digital channels are a primary medium for engagement; successful outreach should leverage online tools and platforms to collect and connect citizen views.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shift from feedback collection to active engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: In October 2006, the Feedback Unit was restructured to move beyond gathering public feedback to become the lead agency for engaging and connecting with citizens, and was re-named REACH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggests a qualitative expectation: engagement should move beyond passive feedback collection to proactive, connective, and facilitative activities that build relationships with citizens.
